title: Build Failed when installing the library
body:
I get this error `react_native_audio_playback-Swift.h not found` when trying to build the library. I'm using react-native 0.76 with new architecture enabled.

Install instructions are not complete but I did run `pod install`, cleaned build folders, tried quite a few things.
author: cristianrosu

comments.body: Can you please provide a repo?

@itsramiel  thanks for the fast reply, I cannot unfortunately as I'm working on a client project. I'm trying to replace the very old `react-native-sound`. Just installing your library causes the error. Have you tried it in a new 0.76 project with fabric enabled by default?

@cristianrosu yes it is tested against 0.76 and new arch.

Can you please try the newly released 1.0.3?

I believe you have frameworks enabled in your ios project by having:
`use_frameworks! :linkage => :static` in Podfile which leads to the error you mentioned. I created a pr to handle that. Let me know if it works now.
@cristianrosu was the issue fixed? I would like to finalize this issue
Closed because fix is there and no activity
